item.description: China, Japan and other US partners oppose Trump’s planned tariff hikes after a Section 301 “excess capacity” probe. Duties up to 35% could start early next year, raising prices, analysts warn.

item.title: New trade war could be brewing following tariff proposal
item.description: Trump plans new tariff hikes for early next year, targeting 14 economies including China, the EU, India and Japan. Rates could hit 35% and China 40%. Allies push back, GOP critics warn on prices.

item.title: 2 baby meerkats make their debut at a Peruvian zoo, spotlighting conservation
item.description: A private zoo in Lima unveiled two baby meerkats born in Peru, spotlighting wildlife conservation and biodiversity. NaviFauna says meerkats are not pets, noting 8 of its 15 were born locally since 2025.

item.title: Mexican president blasts DEA over tip lines, accusing it of not fighting fentanyl enough
item.description: Mexico President Claudia Sheinbaum calls the DEA’s new anonymous tip lines “interference,” citing an AP report alleging agents let 1.4M counterfeit fentanyl pills go unseized, as US pressure on cartels grows.
